description: One-factor contact-robustness PPO candidate on the pinned high-speed drift_drl turn. Same original004 parent, reward, friction, 50/200Hz clocks, motor-v1 randomization, seed42 and fixed two-engine gate as the worst-substep trial. Only during training, randomly assign robot restitution in [0,0.3] (32 material buckets); deterministic evaluation retains zero robot/ground restitution. No MuJoCo contact response changes are part of the nominal paired gate.
